title: Make no mistake, Kyler Murray will be the Vikings' starting QB. So what happens with J.J. McCarthy?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Make no mistake, Kyler Murray will be the Vikings' starting QB. So what happens with J.J. McCarthy?
sources.description: Among McCarthy's options: Ride out 2026 and hope for something to change between Murray and the Vikings after the season. Or compete for the starting job, then request a fresh start if Minnesota doesn't choose him.
